note: IDENTITY AND PROFILE METADATA ONLY. This file deliberately does NOT list which Node versions are supported — that list lives in docs/compat/node-v4.json and is sliced by position at min_supported, so there is exactly one place to move a floor. This file supplies what that list cannot: which commit each tag pointed at when it was first resolved, and what a case against it claims. A version the manifest supports but this file does not pin fails the plan rather than being tested against whatever the tag points at today.
